men: Charcoal and black head to toe
Stark optical white next to the face
women: Icy pastels that look chalky on you

spring.indian_skin_notes: Spring shows up where warmth and clarity meet. On fair skin it reads as peachy or golden with a light flush. On wheatish skin it often looks like golden warmth, and clear warm colours such as coral and turquoise make it glow. On dusky skin it shows as a golden or honey glow, and bright warm colours hold their own without washing you out. Spring is a warm season, but warm undertones appear on every skin depth. No season is better than another. Each one is a different set of colours that work harder on you.

summer.name: Summer
summer.one_line: Cool and soft. Your colours look calm, dusty and gently blended.

men: Mustard and golden yellow near the face
women: Very high contrast black and white

summer.indian_skin_notes: Summer shows up as a cool, soft tone with a pink or rosy edge. On fair skin it often reads as pink-beige with soft contrast. On wheatish skin it can look like an olive or rosy-beige base, where muted cool colours feel calm and even. On dusky skin it shows as a cool, smoky depth, and soft blues, plums and dusty roses look rich instead of loud. Cool undertones exist on every depth of Indian skin. No season is better than another. Summer simply likes blended, quiet colour.

signature_look.women: A dusty rose or lilac kurta with a soft grey-blue dupatta, silver jhumkas and muted nude sandals. Soft and composed.

autumn.name: Autumn
autumn.one_line: Warm and muted. Your colours look earthy, rich and a little spiced.

men: Pure black next to the face

autumn.indian_skin_notes: Autumn shows up as warm, earthy depth. On fair skin it can read as golden, freckled or peachy with soft contrast. On wheatish skin it often looks like a warm bronze or golden base, where earthy colours like olive and rust feel natural. On dusky skin it shows as a rich golden-brown glow, and deep spice colours look at home. Warm undertones appear on every skin depth. No season is better than another. Autumn simply likes warmth that is not loud.

signature_look.women: A terracotta or rust kurta set with an olive-and-mustard dupatta, antique gold jewellery and tan kolhapuris. Rich and warm.

winter.name: Winter
winter.one_line: Cool and clear. Your colours look crisp, deep and high in contrast.

women: Beige and camel head to toe

winter.indian_skin_notes: Winter shows up as cool clarity and strong contrast. On fair skin it often reads as porcelain or rosy with dark hair and a clear edge. On wheatish skin it can look like a cool olive base, where sharp colours like cobalt and emerald look striking. On dusky skin it shows as a deep, cool richness, and bright jewel colours look luminous. Cool undertones exist on every depth of Indian skin. No season is better than another. Winter simply likes crisp colour and strong contrast.
